title: Lentil and spinach curry with rice
steps: Start the rice if it isn't cooked yet: white rice takes about 15 minutes (follow the pack).
Chop the onion and crush a clove of garlic and a little ginger. Drain and rinse the lentils if they are tinned.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder to taste and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and lentils with a splash of water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, season with salt, and serve with the rice.
